name: QuantMatmul

pertoken_scale.description: optional per-token scale, shape [m], dtype float32

bias.description: optional bias term, shape [n] or [batch, 1, n], dtype bfloat16/float32/int32

output_dtype.description: str, output data type selector (float16/bfloat16/int32/int8); default=None

group_sizes.description: optional list of int, group quantization granularity
